requirements.requirement: The system must expose a backend API endpoint within evaluate_care_facade for retrieving prescription behavior analysis by provider NPI.
The system must call the prescribing appropriateness scoring service (from EVAL-P-RX-S3) when the endpoint is invoked.
The system must return a normalized prescribing appropriateness score in the API response.
The system must include a human-readable summary explaining the prescribing behavior in the API response.
The system must include condition-level breakdowns of prescribing patterns in the API response when available.
The system must format the API response according to the evaluation response schema pattern used in evaluate_care_facade.
The system must support JSON response output consumable by downstream UI and chat services.
The system must validate that a provider NPI is provided as input to the endpoint.
The system must return an error response when the provider NPI is missing or invalid.
The system must return an empty or fallback response with explanatory messaging when no prescribing data is available for the provider.
The system must handle partial data scenarios by returning available scores and clearly indicating incomplete data coverage.
The system must log each API request and response status for monitoring and debugging purposes.
The system must ensure response latency remains within acceptable service limits for Evaluate Care APIs.
The system must prevent propagation of internal service errors by returning a standardized error response when the scoring service fails.
